text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I fell short of victory...
Good grief, how pathetic of me—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...However, this is my current strength.
I must face and accept the reality before me."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
How one conducts oneself when failing to achieve
the deserved result is also crucial.
choice_data_list: It's because I'm always being watched, you know.
It's because I'm always being watched, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
...I will definitely make use of today's results for the future.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, you too—never forget how to behave
properly as the one who supports me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Impressive as always.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: President—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Pardon the intrusion when you must be tired right after the race.
I was just a bit concerned about how you were doing.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I am terribly sorry
for showing you such a pathetic display.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Nonsense. If anything, hearing your conversation
just now helped me understand quite well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The unyielding majesty of the "Empress"—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Dispelling my needless worries, that is.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I am deeply humbled by your generous evaluation.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
On the road ahead, I fully intend to dedicate myself
to showing running worthy of your words.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm looking forward to seeing how you perform
in the Classic Year too. Well then, see you later—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
choice_data_list: Let's have our review meeting when we get back.
Let's have our review meeting when we get back.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Yeah, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We have no time to wallow in regret.
Let us press on toward our next victory.

A fiery passion burns deep within Air Groove's eyes...!
She vowed in her heart to treat today as fuel to ensure success next time!

—Though she didn't win the Hanshin JF,
public attention on Air Groove
was steadily growing.
Which path she'll pursue in the Classic Year has been a daily topic of debate in the media.

I'll need to talk to Air Groove again.
For now, I decide to head over to the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Mmhââ

While on my way to the dorms,
I ran into Air Groove in front of the school gate.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Saved me some trouble, then.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I actually have something to discuss with you.
I was just thinking about contacting you.
choice_data_list: I wanted to talk to Air Groove too.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"—Heh. Very well.
Let us take this elsewhere."
When I confided in Air Groove that I wanted to consult her about upcoming races—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'll take the Tiara route.
—Our goal is the 'Triple Tiara.'

Air Groove declared without a shred of hesitation.
Her tone was even firmer and more powerful than usual.

The Tiara route.
It refers to running in three races: the Oka Sho, the Oaks, and the Shuka Sho.
Both are prestigious GⅠ races, and winning either would carve one's name into history, but—

"The Triple Tiara"
is the supreme honor bestowed only upon those
who conquer all three of those races.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The legendary Umamusume of the past who ran the Tiara route
all combined grace and nobility within their strength.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What I must demonstrate is the same—not merely strength alone.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
A figure who captivates all who watch, someone whom
every Umamusume yearns to become and chases after—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"That is the ideal I must demonstrate.
A figure befitting the title of 'Empress.'"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, taking on the "Triple Tiara"
is essential in manifesting that ideal.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Above all...
the Oaks is my origin.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
To establish myself as the "Empress,"
I must produce results in the Oaks.

...The starting point for Air Groove.
That would be the existence of her mother, who conquered the Oaks in the past.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If she announces she's taking the Tiara route, fans will naturally
anticipate a 'Mother-Daughter Consecutive Yushun Himba (Oaks) Victory.'

The pressure weighing on her is immeasurable.
As her Trainer, what can I do—
